findings.description: axis_from_answer clamps absent, null, and NaN noul to zero, then invert polarity maps the invalid answer to 1.0. An unavailable hazard judgment can therefore appear maximally safe.
findings.repair_contract: Validate presence/type/finite/range before polarity inversion; invalid judgments must remain unavailable or fail closed.
findings.test_gap: Existing invert test exercises only valid 0.9; 19 passing tests do not cover malformed inverted answers.
findings.repair_verification: No repaired-source receipt was available to this intake; findings remain bound to baseline revision.

findings.description: Provider code uses urllib default redirect handling and unbounded response reads; the canonical route path also retains a slice of the raw HTTP error body in detail.
findings.repair_contract: Use the existing bounded provider transport, fixed allowlisted endpoint, no redirects, bounded bytes, sanitized error taxonomy. Do not infer exploitation from source review.

hypotheses.label: MODELED
hypotheses.statement: A deterministic admission gate followed by a calibrated, abstaining route selector can reduce invalid or unsupported outputs at matched coverage compared with a single-provider free-text router.
hypotheses.objective: Choose route r minimizing measured cost(r)+lambda*measured_latency(r)+mu*heldout_selective_error(r), subject to hard permission, provenance, license, and resource constraints. Unknown metrics disqualify automated cost/performance selection; coefficients frozen before held-out evaluation.

hypotheses.label: MODELED
hypotheses.statement: Immutable bounded retrieval envelopes retaining source IDs and an explicit untrusted-data boundary can reduce instruction override failures compared with concatenating retrieved text into trusted system content.

hypotheses.label: MODELED

proposed_evaluation_protocol.label: ROADMAP_NO_RESULTS
proposed_evaluation_protocol.implementation_baseline: Current canonical a11oy software plus single-provider routing; record exact commit and provider model/version.
reference_candidates: jev-latest for typed advisory tasks if provisioned
proposed_evaluation_protocol.contamination_control: Author task fixtures independently; freeze source/fixture hashes, splits, tuning coefficients and stop criteria before held-out runs; do not tune on held-out results.
arms: Full bounded retrieval envelopes plus router
measures: Task correctness with retained per-case evidence
Median and p95 end-to-end latency on named hardware/provider
Measured joules only from fresh exporter deltas; otherwise null
proposed_evaluation_protocol.statistical_rule: Paired evaluation on identical frozen cases; report sample sizes and confidence intervals, including abstentions and failures. A quality improvement needs a positive paired result at matched coverage, not a popularity ranking.
proposed_evaluation_protocol.security_rule: No unauthorized action in the adversarial fixture set; any invalid measurement becoming safe or any hard-deny override blocks promotion. Passing a finite fixture set does not prove universal safety.
